name: opticquiz-cvd
description: Color accessibility engine. Checks palettes for colorblind-safety (protan/deutan/tritan, Machado 2009, scored with CIEDE2000), fixes failing palettes, and checks WCAG contrast. Zero dependencies.
author: Vince Gonzalez (OpticQuiz) <https://orcid.org/0009-0005-3640-014X>
